Dots and other small marks

Source: R/marks.R
bb_dot.Rd

One or more filled marks in a row: stock-out dots, schedule dots and diamonds. `color`, `shape` and `size` are recycled to the longest, so `bb_dot("primary", shape = c("circle", "circle", "diamond"))` draws two dots and a diamond. Marks are centred vertically and separated by `gap`.

Usage

bb_dot(
  color,
  size = 10/96,
  shape = "circle",
  gap = 3/96,
  align = c("left", "center", "right")
)

Arguments

color

Mark colour(s); theme names allowed. Marks with an `NA` colour are skipped.

size

Mark size(s) (`grid::unit` or inches). Default 10px.

shape

`"circle"`, `"square"` or `"diamond"`, one per mark or recycled.

gap

Space between marks.

align

Horizontal position in its slot. Inside [bb_table()] the column alignment places it instead.

Value

A block.

Examples

bb_dot("#2F7D55")
#> <bb_dot>
bb_dot("primary", size = c(7, 7, 9) / 96, shape = c("circle", "circle", "diamond"))
#> <bb_dot>
